journey.name: Wallet pill renders
journey.description:
The SDK's wallet pill must render in the host app's top bar on a cold start, before any sigil exists, showing the sigil chip and the NIGHT balance slot.
This is the drop-in panel the SDK promises consumers: if WalletAppShell stops mounting it, or it throws during composition on a wallet-less session, a dApp loses its entire wallet surface while the rest of the app still renders. Nothing in the SDK's own unit tests sees that, because it only happens once the panel is hosted by a real app.

actions.action: Verify the screen does NOT show "Something went wrong"
